body:
Doing this.blah works and appears to be in the unit tests. Except that is useless in practice since omitting the "this." gives equivalent code. What *is* useful is returning or copying "this". Doing so errors in DXC but does not in FXC with the following:

error: cannot compile this aggregate expression yet
